verdict.rationale: The audit-log half is well documented. Snowsight Query History monitors queries executed by users over the last 14 days, and the ACCESS_HISTORY view records reads and writes for compliance auditing, including which tables and columns were accessed. Column-level lineage of where data came from is only implied by access history's write tracking and column-level access insights; no lineage capability is explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit column-level lineage documentation (source-to-target column mapping or lineage graph), retention beyond 14 days for query history, independent hands-on corroboration.
